title: Refactor Go Tests to Load Data From Shared Asset Files
description: Refactor the Go test file at compose/go/main_test.go to load hardcoded test data from shared JSON asset files in assets/compose/. All hardcoded GUIDs, design names, piece names, expected values, hash strings, glob patterns, expected counts must be loaded from asset files. Test behavior stays in Go code, only data moves to assets.
summary:
Refactored all 7 Go test functions in `compose/go/main_test.go` to load hardcoded test data from shared JSON asset files in `assets/compose/`:

1. **TestFlatten** - Kit filenames and design paths loaded from `flatten.cases.compose.json`
2. **TestDesignQualitySum** - Design name, quality name, expected value, tolerance loaded from `quality-sum.cases.compose.json`
3. **TestFilterKit** - Design GUIDs and glob patterns loaded from `filter-kit.cases.compose.json`
4. **TestHashKit** - Kit filename and expected hash loaded from `hash.cases.compose.json`
5. **TestHashKitDiff** - KitDiff JSON and expected hash loaded from `hash.cases.compose.json`
6. **TestDesignWithDiff** - Design name, diff/expected files, and expected counts loaded from `design-with-diff.cases.compose.json`
7. **TestFindReplaceableTypesInDesigns** - All 6 sub-tests (connected piece, isolated piece, capital piece, multiple pieces, synthetic, boundary) plus new selection_asset case loaded from `find-replaceable-types.cases.compose.json` and `synthetic-find-replaceable.kit.compose.json`

Additional fixes:
- Added ~150 lines of asset struct types (`selectionAsset`, `flattenCasesAsset`, `qualitySumCasesAsset`, `hashCasesAsset`, `designWithDiffCasesAsset`, `filterKitCasesAsset`, `findReplaceableCasesAsset`, etc.)
- Removed unused `strconv` import (was only used by inline synthetic kit builders, now loaded from JSON)
- Fixed pre-existing bug: `BenchmarkValidateKit_Invalid`/`BenchmarkValidateKit_Metabolism` used `result.Issues` but the field is `result.Problems`
- Fixed `find-replaceable-types.cases.compose.json` `selection_asset_returns_compatible_guids` case: corrected `expectedTypeGuids` (was wrong) and `expectedDesignGuids` to match actual function output
